criteria.reasoning: For P-01 the review gives "Deductible Amount: $420.00 ($750.00 payment − $330.00 FMV of goods/services)", and it values the two seats "at approved FMV of $165.00 per guest, totaling $330.00".

P-01's acknowledgment must include a "Description of goods and services provided: 2 gala seats including seated three-course dinner, open bar, live band, and dancing", a "Good-faith estimate of the fair market value of benefits provided ($330.00)", and the disclosure "that the tax-deductible contribution is limited to the excess of payment over the value of goods and services provided".

The review values P-02's benefits at "10 gala seats at $165.00 ($1,650.00) plus 10 VIP pre-gala reception admissions at $40.00 ($400.00), yielding a total FMV of $2,050.00". It says program listing and signage "constitute donor recognition and have no value".
P-02's deductible amount is "$7,950.00 ($10,000.00 payment − $2,050.00 FMV of benefits)", and the review requires the CRM "Receipt amount" to change "from $6,250.00 to $7,950.00".

P-03 gets "Deductible Amount: $375.00", and her acknowledgment must state "No goods or services were provided in exchange for your contribution." The reason given is that "the donor declined benefits in writing at payment and no seat was reserved". The review corrects the benefit value to $0.00 and the receipt amount to $375.00.

P-04 gets "Deductible Amount: $420.00". The acknowledgment must describe the 2 gala seats, give "$330.00", and carry the §6115 disclosure. The review directs "Disapprove Dana Whitcomb's pending modification" because the donors "still received the benefit because the seats were reserved and available; the deductible amount cannot be increased".

P-05 gets "Deductible Amount: $200.00 ... $0.00 of the $100.00 raffle purchase is deductible". The acknowledgment must state that raffle payments "are not charitable contributions and are not tax-deductible", and must not "count the $100.00 raffle purchase in the charitable contribution total". No goods or services were provided for the $200 contribution.

P-06 gets "Deductible Amount: $1,500.00", and the acknowledgment states "No goods or services were provided." It explicitly "Must not deduct any benefit value for the gala dinner seat she occupied as a guest of Drs. Vasquez-Hart" because that seat is the sponsor's benefit.

P-07 gets "Deductible Amount: $60.00", and the review says the acknowledgment must state "No goods or services were provided in exchange for your contribution", noting acknowledgments are provided "for all gifts regardless of amount".
P-08 gets "Deductible Amount: $30.00 ($195.00 payment − $165.00 FMV of gala seat)". The review requires the §6115 disclosure and a $165.00 good-faith estimate "Because the payment exceeds $75.00".
